about: The SovereignWebsite organisation's repositories, as code. org-apply creates any that are missing and keeps their settings as written here. It never deletes, transfers, archives or makes private (policy/abp.json). Each site repository is seeded with the files in its seed/ folder (only files that are missing are added), Pages on from a workflow on dev, and its apex domain. Every repository gives the teams in defaults.teams their permission (the agents' team gets push, never admin).

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Factory
repos.description: Control repository: the organisation as code, and requests for hosted sovereign websites on sovereignwebsite.site. Driven by CI under an Agent Behaviour Policy.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Website
repos.description: sovereignwebsite.ai: the Sovereign Agentic Website brand. Built by agents, owned by you.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Org
repos.description: sovereignwebsite.org: the open pattern for a Sovereign Agentic Website, free for anyone to use.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Site
repos.description: sovereignwebsite.site: where hosted sovereign websites live, at <name>.sovereignwebsite.site.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Hub
repos.description: hub.sovereignwebsite.site: the gallery of sovereign websites, each with its owner, team, address, repository, vault, licence and versions.

repos.name: SovereignWebsite__Vault
repos.description: vault.sovereignwebsite.site: the base for sovereign websites powered by sgit vaults; each site lives in a public repository and an sgit vault holding the same files.
